caption:
Three kinds of hello

I used to greet people with a nod and keep moving. Then I started stopping to say hello.

The first seconds of a meeting tend to set its tone, and a greeting that stops moving for a moment is easy to remember.

For whoever stops for a proper hello.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.
